content:
Deletes the specified scan configuration and all associated scan history and vulnerabilities. You
cannot delete a scan configuration if a scan based on that configuration is currently running.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS.MANAGE  custom role privilege.
Additionally, requires the Can Edit [64] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
string <uuid>
The UUID of the scan configuration you want to delete.
